config.universe: A-share main board, PRIMARY_3PLUS and RECYCLE_2PLUS rearmed to >=3 boards; exactly-2-board R2 observations never bought
config.rule_priority: Earliest causally executable Day2 signal wins; same stock/event one buy
config.expansion_scope: LM3 and W5 only PRIMARY_3PLUS; frozen R4/P3/PV may include RECYCLE_2PLUS with >=3 boards

T1_exits.B4P_PANIC_CAPITULATION_OPEN: if first minute profit >8%, M2 open, else close
T1_exits.PANIC_3_LIQ_RECLAIM45: if 5-minute rise vs T1 open >0.5%, M6 open, else close
T1_exits.NORMAL_B4P_LIQUID_M3: if 3-minute rise vs T1 open >5%, M4 open, else close
T1_exits.POS_4P_VOLUME_RECLAIM35: if 3-minute price vs entry <-2%, M4 open, else close
T1_exits.CORE_RED_4P_REPAIR45: if 3-minute fall vs T1 open <-1.5%, M4 open, else close

config.execution_note: Only a paper model. A bar open/close is a quote/price proxy, not guaranteed fill.
config.retrospective_asof_note: Signals first generated after the price event are classified as backfilled OOS, never contemporaneous alerts.

scope: Prospective monitoring from Day1 Oct 8 close onward. No retrospective re-tuning.
